rv.q: Even when Barnes overstates his case, as he does by having Jack assume the role of a serial killer, the play is held together by McAvoy's mesmerising performance.
McAvoy's journey through the play's different moods is a tour de force.

cn.t: James McAvoy delivers a mesmerizing, charismatic performance in this exuberant revival of Barnes's subversive 1968 satire, whose pitch-black comedy and caustic attack on the Establishment remain chillingly relevant despite occasionally blatant class antagonism.
